directories.title: Directories
directories.subtitle: User directories in precedence order. When two directories know the same username, the first active one owns it.
directories.synced: Synced {name}: {added} added, {updated} updated, {deactivated} deactivated, {groups} groups, {memberships} memberships.
directories.addedWithWarnings: {name} is added. Its settings have warnings:
directoryDetail.deleteDescription: Its synced accounts and groups are removed.
directoryDetail.testLoginHint: Checks each step of signing in against this directory.
directoryForm.name: Name
directoryForm.syncIntervalHint: Leave blank to sync only on demand.
directoryForm.keepSecret: Leave blank to keep the stored value
accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.subtitle: The accounts you may see. Your rules decide which directories are included.
accounts.createHint: Internal accounts live in the {product} directory and sign in with a password.
accountDetail.identitiesHint: One row per directory that knows this username. The first active directory in precedence order wins; the others are shadowed.
accountDetail.noGroups: Not a member of any group.
accountDetail.secondFactor.title: Two-factor sign-in
accountDetail.secondFactor.resetHint: Their authenticator apps and recovery codes stop working. If a group of theirs requires a second factor, they set one up again at their next sign-in. Do this only once you're sure it's really them asking.
accountName.label: Display name
accountName.saved: The name is {name} now, wherever it shows.
accountName.languagesHint: Give your name in each of the site's languages: people reading in that language see it. The English one is kept in history.
groups.title: Groups
groups.subtitle: Local groups are created in {product}; synced groups come from a directory. Groups can contain other groups.
groups.kindHint: An organization is a group customers belong to, by hand or by their email’s domain.
groups.domainsHint: People whose email is in one of these domains join it (acme.com). Separate them with commas.
groupDetail.readOnlyNotice: This group is read-only in {product}: its members come from directory sync.
groupDetail.directoryNotice: {product} puts everyone whose account comes from this directory in this group. Grant it a role to give it to the whole directory, or nest it in another group.
groupDetail.ouNotice: Everyone under this OU in the directory, at any depth, from the last sync. Change the OUs in the directory’s settings.
groupDetail.organizationHint: Customers in an organization can share their requests with each other where a request type allows it.
groupDetail.attributesHint: One per line: name = value (customer number = 1042).
groupDetail.twoFactor.title: Two-factor sign-in
groupDetail.twoFactor.hint: Whether members are asked for a second factor. Each person follows the strictest of all their groups, nested ones too.
groupDetail.twoFactor.modeHints.off: Members aren't asked, unless they set one up themselves.
groupDetail.twoFactor.modeHints.optional: Offered at sign-in and never asked; members who set one up are asked.
groupDetail.twoFactor.modeHints.required: Members set up a second factor and enter a code at every sign-in.
groupDetail.twoFactor.modeHints.strong: As Required, and only with an authenticator app, not codes by email or SMS.
groupDetail.namesHint: People reading in a language see the group's name in it. The English one is kept in history and by the directory.
signUpSettings.title: Sign-up
signUpSettings.subtitle: Whether people may create their own accounts. They confirm their email first; what they may use is up to the roles you grant.
signUpSettings.directoryHint: Sign-ups are created in this internal directory. Add one such as Customers under Directories.
signUpSettings.domainsHint: Only these domains may sign up; empty takes any. Separate them with commas.
signUpSettings.grantHint: To give sign-ups a project, grant its Customer role to the group {group} in the project’s members.
anonymousAccess.title: Anonymous access
anonymousAccess.subtitle: Every role given to anonymous visitors. Anyone on the internet gets these, so keep them few.
anonymousAccess.empty: Anonymous visitors have no roles anywhere.
merge.pageHint: Everything {username} did, owns or is named in moves to the account you choose: records, comments, history, grants, groups, views, dashboards, subscriptions and what plugins keep. {username} stays, inactive, and can't sign in.
merge.alreadyMerged: This account was merged into {survivor} already.
merge.chooseHint: Usually the person's real account: the one they sign in with.
merge.searchPlaceholder: Search by username, name or email
merge.sourceHint: Stays as an inactive account, merged into the other.
merge.previewHint: Counted now; {product}'s own modules move in one transaction, plugins right after.
merge.activeWarning: {username} can sign in. After the merge it can't: its owner signs in with the other account.
merge.activeOtherDirectory: {username} can sign in, from another directory. After the merge it can't: its owner signs in with the other account. Merge only if they're the same person.
merge.noUndo: A merge can't be undone. It's recorded on both accounts.
merge.mergedIncomplete: {source} merged into {survivor}, but a plugin didn't finish: resume it from the account's merges.
merge.mergedBanner: This account was merged into <survivor></survivor>: its work, rights and addresses are there now. It can't sign in.
merge.title: Merges ({count})
merge.hint: Accounts merged into this one, or this one into another. Nothing here can be undone.
merge.count.grants: {count, plural, one {# role grant} other {# role grants}}
merge.count.memberships: {count, plural, one {# group membership} other {# group memberships}}
merge.count.tokens: {count, plural, one {# access token revoked} other {# access tokens revoked}}
duplicates.title: Possible duplicates ({count})
duplicates.hint: Accounts that share an address: often one person twice, such as someone a Jira import couldn't match. Merge them to make one.
addresses.title: Email addresses ({count})
addresses.adminHint: Every confirmed address finds this account: mail in, participants, sign-up and organizations by domain. Addresses you add are confirmed at once; mail goes to the one chosen.
addresses.selfHint: Every confirmed address finds your account: mail you send in, requests shared with you, organizations by domain. We mail a link to each address you add; it counts once you follow it.
addresses.linkSent: We sent a link to {email}. It counts once you follow it.
addresses.primaryChanged: {email} is the primary address now. The one before stays confirmed, and was told.
addresses.fromDirectory: The name and primary address come from {directory}: change them there, and the next sync brings them here.
common.name: Name
secondFactor.disabled: This site's operator has switched two-factor sign-in off for now: nobody is asked for a code.
